provenance.note: CD is SAMPLED on cl_ladder, not fitted. A quadratic CD(CL) was measured at median RMS 20.7-26.0% and worst 271% on the attached branch, because a laminar drag bucket at Re 1e5-1e6 puts a kink in the polar. cd_at_cl entries are null above that section's CLmax. Values past CLmax are NOT stored: CD(CL) is not single-valued there.
